sentences.text: No—the documents do not state a 2% cap; the current RBI direction says no upper limit / cap for penal charges has been prescribed.

The current RBI direction says penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract, and there is no capitalization of the penal charges.
The bank’s own documents state ₹500 per month of default in the home loan agreement and KFS, and 1% per annum on the amount in default for MSE business loans.

missing.slot: maximum penal charge as a universal percentage cap
missing.searched: RBI cap at 2% and current RBI directions on penal charges
